title: 第5章 不知道够不够第6章 这个挨千刀的
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 不多时，二人来到了一处精致的别院，主院被秦关昨晚拆了，所以南云起他们搬到了这里。
此时，一家三口正在享用早餐，当三人看到秦关拉着南柔进来后顿时一愣。
尤其是杨红梅，她指着秦关，嘴巴张合着，一时间不知道说什么，找了一晚上，这个废物竟然敢主动送上门？
“伯父伯母早啊，怎么吃饭也不叫我们！”秦关咧嘴一笑，冲他们打招呼。
南柔急忙走到秦关前面：“柔儿见过父亲母亲大人！”
杨红梅直接无视南柔，她指着秦关：“好你个废物，来人啊！”
话音落下，四名护卫冲了进来。
“退下！”南云起突然冲着四名护卫呵斥。
见状四名护卫稍微迟疑了下，而后退了出去。
“老爷，你做什么，这个废物杀了胡六，为何不将他拿下？”杨红梅看向南云起气道。
不等南云起开口，秦关突然冷哼一声：“一条敢咬主人的狗，难道不该杀吗？”
“你这话是何意？”南云起皱眉道。
秦关看向南云起：“这么冷的天，那胡六故意不给南柔木炭取暖，差点将她冻死，而且还出言侮辱她，伯父你觉得他该不该杀？”
南云起听后脸色变得难看，他看向杨红梅，很多事情其实他都知道一些，但他没曾想杨红梅竟然做的这么过分。
“废物，你胡说什么，胡六他什么时候短过柔儿生活物资了，该给的哪一样不是顶好的给她？”杨红梅脸不红气不粗的说道。
这时，南柔突然开口，她声音不大但却带着几分责怪之意：
“多和少我不介意，但是还请母亲不要一口一个废物称呼关哥。”
“反了反了，老爷你看看你这养的这个好闺女，现在都敢这么跟我说话了，简直目无尊长啊！”
杨红梅先是一愣，平时像个鹌鹑一样的南柔，今天竟然敢跟她阴阳怪气，她的眼底闪过一抹阴狠，小贱人怕是活的不耐烦了！
“娘，您就少说两句吧，过两天就是姐姐和秦关的大喜之日了，我们应该祝福他们，给他们好好筹办婚礼才是正事。”
一直未说话的南乔突然开口，现在秦关只要答应和南柔在一起别缠着自己就行。
“乔儿说的没错，以后都是一家人了，一家人要和和气气才是！”南云起点头。
如今南家还靠着杨红梅娘家那边支持，很多事情说实话他也很无奈，只能睁一只眼闭一只眼。
闻言，杨红梅欲言又止，将火气压下，她自然明白南乔的意思，胡六比起自己闺女的名声不算什么，至于这口气，等二人成亲后有的是机会出。
“快去拿两副碗筷过来！”
南云起冲着门口的丫鬟吩咐了一声，然后笑着看向南柔：“柔儿，今天你气色好多了，脸上都有血色了。”
闻言，南柔高兴道：“爹，还没告诉您，我的寒毒被关哥解了，我现在已经好了！”
“什么！”
听到南柔的话，南云起猛的站了起来，他急忙将手指搭向南柔的脉搏，片刻后，他又惊又喜：“哈哈，确实没了，那可怕的寒毒确实没了！”
“秦少侠，请受老夫一拜！”
南云起眼眶泛红，突然朝着秦关深深一礼。
南柔自幼丧母，他这个父亲说实话做的很失败，对南柔是满心的愧疚，现在看到女儿病好了，他是打心底感激秦关。
一旁的杨红梅和南乔得知南柔的寒毒被秦关解除后也是惊讶不已。
那么多能人异士都没办法的寒毒竟然让这个废物治好了？
“岳父给姑爷行礼，这礼我可受不起啊！”秦关将南云起扶起开玩笑道。
听到秦关的话，南云起脸色一黑，急忙起身挺了挺腰板。
南柔则是在一旁捂嘴偷笑。
“哼，没出息！”
杨红梅冷哼一声起身离开，跟这两人坐一桌吃饭，打死她都不愿意。
content_en:
Not long after, the two came to an exquisite courtyard. The main courtyard was demolished by Qin Guan last night, so Nan Yunqi and the others moved here.
At this time, a family of three was enjoying breakfast. When the three of them saw Qin Guan pulling Nan Rou in, they were stunned.
Especially Yang Hongmei. She pointed at Qin Guan and opened and closed her mouth. She didn't know what to say for a while. After searching all night, this trash actually dared to take the initiative to deliver it to her door?
"Good morning, uncle and aunt, why don't you call us for dinner!" Qin Guan grinned and greeted them.
Nan Rou hurriedly walked to Qin Guan: "Rou'er has met your father and mother!"
Yang Hongmei ignored Nan Rou and pointed at Qin Guan: "You trash, come here!"
As soon as the words fell, four guards rushed in.
"Back off!" Nan Yunqi suddenly shouted at the four guards.
Seeing this, the four guards hesitated for a moment, then stepped back.
"Master, what are you doing? This loser killed Hu Liu, why don't you take him down?" Yang Hongmei looked at Nan Yun and said angrily.
Before Nan Yunqi could speak, Qin Guan suddenly snorted coldly: "Shouldn't a dog that dares bite its owner be killed?"
"What do you mean by this?" Nan Yunqi frowned.
Qin Guan looked at Nan Yunqi: "In such a cold weather, Hu Liu deliberately didn't give Nan Rou charcoal to warm her up, almost freezing her to death, and he even insulted her. Uncle, do you think he should be killed?"
After hearing this, Nan Yunqi's face turned ugly. He looked at Yang Hongmei. He actually knew a lot of things, but he never thought that Yang Hongmei would go so far.
"Trash, what are you talking about? When did Hu Liu lose more than Rou'er's daily necessities? What should he give her that is not the best?" Yang Hongmei said with a neither blush nor anger.
At this time, Nan Rou suddenly spoke, her voice was not loud but it contained a bit of blame:
"I don't mind more or less, but please don't call Brother Guan a loser, mother."
"You're on the wrong side. Master, look at this good girl you raised. She dares to talk to me like this now. She's so disrespectful!"
Yang Hongmei was stunned at first. Nan Rou, who was usually like a quail, actually dared to be weird with her today. There was a hint of viciousness in her eyes. The little bitch was probably impatient!
"Mom, please don't say a few words. In two days, it will be my sister and Qin Guan's big day. We should bless them and prepare a good wedding for them. That's the business."
Nan Qiao, who had been silent until now, suddenly said, now Qin Guan only needs to promise to be with Nan Rou and not pester him.
"Qiao Er is right, we are all a family from now on, and a family must be harmonious!" Nan Yun nodded.
Now the Nan family still relies on the support of Yang Hongmei's mother's family. To be honest, he is helpless in many things and can only turn a blind eye.
Hearing this, Yang Hongmei stopped talking and suppressed her anger. She naturally understood what Nan Qiao meant. Hu Liu's reputation was nothing compared to her daughter's. As for this tone, there would be plenty of opportunities for her to express it after the two got married.
"Go and get two pairs of bowls and chopsticks!"
Nan Yunqi gave instructions to the maid at the door, and then looked at Nan Rou with a smile: "Rou'er, you look much better today, and there is blood on your face."
Hearing this, Nan Rou said happily: "Dad, I haven't told you yet that my cold poison was cured by Brother Guan, and I'm fine now!"
"What!"
Hearing Nanrou's words, Nan Yunqi stood up suddenly. He quickly put his finger on Nanrou's pulse. After a moment, he was surprised and happy: "Haha, it is indeed gone. The terrible cold poison is indeed gone!"
"Young Master Qin, please accept my respects!"
Nan Yunqi's eyes turned red, and he suddenly bowed deeply to Qin Guan.
Nanrou lost her mother when she was young. To be honest, his father failed very much and felt guilty for Nanrou. Now that his daughter has recovered from her illness, he is grateful to Qin Guan from the bottom of his heart.
Yang Hongmei and Nan Qiao on the side were also surprised when they learned that Nanrou's cold poison was lifted by Qin Guan.
How could this waste be cured of the cold poison that so many experts and strangers couldn't do anything about?
"My father-in-law salutes my uncle. I can't bear this ceremony!" Qin Guan helped Nan Yunqi up and joked.
After hearing Qin Guan's words, Nan Yunqi's face darkened, and he stood up in a hurry and straightened his back.
Nanrou covered her mouth and snickered.
"Huh, no future!"
Yang Hongmei snorted and stood up to leave. She was unwilling to sit at the same table with these two people for dinner even if they killed her.
title_en: Chapter 5 I don’t know if it’s enough Chapter 6 The one who suffered a thousand cuts
